body: I adore this tool — been using it for years. But the PDF export has been broken for a week and it's blocking my workflow. Thought you should know.

subject: Frustrated with the charge but still love you
body: Honestly your product is great, but the duplicate charge this month has me annoyed. Please refund it.

subject: Not a bug but missing functionality
body: I keep expecting to be able to export to XLSX. I know it's not a bug — it's just not there. Can you add it?

subject: Seems like a bug but it's about login
body: Every time I try to log in with SSO I get a 500 error. Could be a bug, could be our SSO config. Can you check?

subject: Love the product, just have a question
body: Been a happy customer for 2 years. Quick question — do you have plans for a mobile app?

subject: Billing page won't load
body: The billing section of my account doesn't load — just a blank screen. Not sure if it's a bug or a permissions issue.

subject: Would love SSO on starter plan
body: I'd pay more if SSO was on our plan. Right now we have to upgrade to enterprise just for that one feature.

subject: Support team bug fix was amazing
body: Reported a bug last night, got a fix deployed by morning. Just wanted to say how impressed I am with your team.
